paras: Application: Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5 and Acura Integra Type S (LHD only) Part Type: CCV Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0825-FL

The Radium 20-0825-FL catch can kit runs inline with the crankcase vent (CCV) port of the Civic Type R's K20C1, separating oil and moisture from crankcase gases before they reach the intake. This helps keep oil out of the intake tract, intercooler, throttle body and manifold, and keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: CCV Circuit: Installs inline with the crankcase vent port
Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock design stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
ft: Radium Engineering CCV Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5
